Our engineering culture

Umbrella builds search and recommendation products used by millions of people. Our engineering team is remote-first and hybrid, with hubs in Berlin and Lisbon, and we collaborate closely with design and data.

At Umbrella our teams design and build products together. We collaborate across disciplines, we value experience and curiosity, and we believe skills grow fastest in a team that shares ownership. Engineers lead design reviews, manage their own roadmaps and develop in the open with stakeholders from every department.

We run hack weeks, reading groups and a mentoring programme, and our remote and hybrid teams meet in person every quarter. Benefits include a learning budget and flexible hours for the whole company.

Our teams own their services end to end: they design the architecture, build it, run it in production and improve it with data. Experience across the company is shared openly, and skills in machine learning, search and infrastructure are developed through pairing, internal talks and conference budgets for every engineer.

The role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy ranking models for our search product.

Responsibilities: train and evaluate ranking models; build feature pipelines in Python; deploy models to production and monitor them; collaborate with product and data science.

Requirements: 3+ years of experience in machine learning engineering; strong Python and PyTorch skills; experience deploying models to production.
